about_the_game:
In a world where the dead turn into zombies, your job is to manage your very own Graveyard! Perform burials and cremations, fulfill visitor requests, manage facilities, and keep your staff and defenses in top shape. But when night falls, everything changes. The dead may rest, but the zombies don’t. They are coming for your precious work!

Visitor Satisfaction is Key

After processing the bodies, visitors will return to check on their loved ones. Your duty is to keep graves intact while providing fresh flowers and maintaining a welcoming environment. Every visit rewards you with valuable bonuses to help your business thrive.

Visitors can also stop by the Chapel to rest, attend sermons, and browse the Souvenir Shop for small keepsakes like candles and incenses. A clean, decorated, and well managed graveyard encourages greater generosity while donating!

Build your Defenses

Each night, waves of zombies will come with their numbers growing and special zombie types emerging, hungry for freshly buried bodies and for you. Some nights may be even more dangerous with special events like the Blood Moon. From basic defenses like barbed wires and fences to advanced machines like flamethrower turrets, keep your defenses upgraded, repaired, and fully stocked with ammo to withstand the night. Your loyal pet companion can also assist you during nighttime defenses.

Trust your Arsenal

With a wide arsenal of 13+ weapons, including pistols, rifles, shotguns, and your trusty shovel, you are the ultimate force against the Zombies. As you level up, unlock and purchase new weapons to become even stronger. Just make sure to stock up on enough ammo!

Even a Graveyard Can Be Cozy Sometimes!

Use your Farming Area to grow different flowers for profit and vegetables to simply eat and restore your energy and health. With Upgrades, you can even unlock a Grinder to turn zombie parts into Fertilizer. Decorate your Graveyard with benches, lights, paths, custom urns, and other ornaments to make it truly your own.

Expand and Upgrade Your Facilities

Your graveyard isn’t just a resting place, it's a business, and every upgrade matters. Expand your burial areas, manage custom urns at the urn station, upgrade your crematorium, and operate new facilities like the Stone Quarry & Workshop to craft your own gravestones. Improve your water supply, manage resource production, and unlock advanced stations like the Zombie Research Lab to process captured zombies into valuable products.

Hire a team of employees to help with day-to-day tasks: the Florist keeps flowers running, the Gravekeeper maintains burials and cremations, the Gardener keeps your farm in check, the Technician ensures all machines run smoothly, and Chapel staff like the Priest, Pianist, and Custodian help run sermons and services.

Every improvement helps you stay one step ahead of both business demands and the undead threat. Venture beyond the graveyard by unlocking Expedition Mode through the Expedition Station, where radio signals lead you to dangerous missions outside your walls.

Key Features

  • Manage and expand your own graveyard while balancing business and survival

  • Build and maintain defenses against nightly zombie attacks

  • Perform burials, cremations, urn deliveries, and keep visitors satisfied

  • Operate a Chapel with sermons, donations, and a Souvenir Shop

  • Hire and manage a wide range of employees

  • Craft gravestones, customize urns, and produce valuable resources

  • Unlock Expedition Mode and complete missions outside the graveyard

  • Decorate your Graveyard with benches, lights, paths, bushes and other ornaments to make it truly your own

  • Customize your playstyle with expanded game modifier

  • Experience a mix of management, strategy, and first-person action
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1300X or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970 / AMD RX 470 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Supports FSR and DLSS. A compatible NVIDIA or AMD graphics card is required for the best performance.
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / RX 5600 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Supports FSR and DLSS. A compatible NVIDIA or AMD graphics card is required for the best performance.
